retrievalProfile.description: A 3x3 grid layout featuring a central character and their puppet likeness against a vibrant cyan background with heavy black borders and centered, outlined block typography.
triggerTerms: 3x3 character grid with thick black borders

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 3x3 grid where eight cells contain a puppet and one cell contains a human, all set against a bright cyan backdrop. The grid is defined by thick black lines, and the center is dominated by large, stacked, outlined sans-serif text integrated with a hand-drawn heart icon.
coreVisualRelationships: Puppet character mimicking human poses across multiple frames
Vibrant cyan background contrasting with thick black grid lines
Large-scale central typography overlapping the middle row
Hand-drawn heart icon replacing or overlapping a letter in the title
coreInvariants: Thick black grid borders separating nine distinct panels
Uniform cyan background color across all panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered within each grid cell; the central text block spans the middle horizontal axis and dominates the visual hierarchy.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central text block and the red heart icon.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central text, then moves outward to explore the individual puppet expressions in the surrounding grid cells.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cyan background provides breathing room within each cell, while thick black lines create a rigid structure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation cyan with high-value white outlines and low-value black elements for maximum pop.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is replaced or obscured by a hand-drawn red heart with 'X' eyes and a smile.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and vertical presence.
Offers a similar geometric but aggressive sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 3x3 grid with thick black borders. Fill the background of all cells with a solid cyan color. Place a puppet character in various poses in 7-8 cells and a human character in the remaining cells.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked uppercase text in the center. Use a black fill with a thick white outline. Replace one central letter with a hand-drawn red heart icon featuring a simple smiley face.

verificationChecks: Is the grid 3x3 with thick black lines?
Is the background a consistent cyan?
Is the text black with a prominent white outline?
Is the heart icon hand-drawn in style?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist likenesses
Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure the heart icon is a generic hand-drawn style

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is centered and stacked.
Verify the cyan color is vibrant and uniform.
Ensure the black grid lines are perfectly horizontal and vertical.
Confirm the white outline on the text is thick and visible against the cyan.
recipe.reuseFormula: 3x3 Cyan Grid + Thick Black Borders + Stacked Outlined Sans-Serif + Character/Puppet Contrast
